import numpy as np

# Probe dev_24 characteristics if accessible; else produce finite structural diagnostics.
try:
    from dev_24 import load_suite
    suite = load_suite()
    names = list(suite.keys())
    print("n_instances", len(names))
    sizes, scales, tight = [], [], []
    for k in names:
        inst = suite[k]
        D = np.asarray(inst["distance_matrix"], dtype=float)
        q = np.asarray(inst["demands"], dtype=float)
        Q = float(inst["capacity"])
        n = D.shape[0] - 1
        sizes.append(n)
        scales.append(float(np.mean(D[0, 1:])))
        tight.append(float(q[1:].sum() / Q) / n)  # vehicles per customer proxy
    RESULT = {
        "n_instances": len(names),
        "mean_size": float(np.mean(sizes)),
        "mean_depot_scale": float(np.mean(scales)),
        "cv_depot_scale": float(np.std(scales) / (np.mean(scales) + 1e-12)),
        "mean_tightness": float(np.mean(tight)),
    }
except Exception as e:
    # Finite structural surrogate: scale-invariance check of normalized generalized savings
    rng = np.random.default_rng(0)
    n = 60
    X = rng.random((n, 2))
    D = np.linalg.norm(X[:, None, :] - X[None, :, :], axis=-1)
    lam, mu = 1.05, 0.10
    d0i = D[0, 1:]
    d0j = d0i
    dij = D[1:, 1:]
    I, J = np.triu_indices(n - 1, k=1)
    scale = np.mean(d0i)
    s = (d0i[I] + d0j[J] - lam * dij[I, J] + mu * np.abs(d0i[I] - d0j[J])) / scale
    # scale invariance
    s2 = (d0i[I] * 1e-3 + d0j[J] * 1e-3 - lam * dij[I, J] * 1e-3 + mu * np.abs(d0i[I] - d0j[J]) * 1e-3) / (scale * 1e-3)
    RESULT = {
        "probe_fallback": 1,
        "n": n,
        "score_mean": float(np.mean(s)),
        "score_std": float(np.std(s)),
        "frac_positive": float(np.mean(s > 0)),
        "scale_invariance_max_abs_diff": float(np.max(np.abs(s - s2))),
        "radius_priority_corr": float(np.corrcoef(s, d0i[I] + d0j[J])[0, 1]),
    }
print(RESULT)

import numpy as np

# Structural diagnostic on L2a generalized normalized savings score:
# quantify radius priority preservation, scale invariance, and clamp/robustness.
rng = np.random.default_rng(0)
n = 60
X = rng.random((n, 2))
D = np.linalg.norm(X[:, None, :] - X[None, :, :], axis=-1)
lam, mu, beta = 1.05, 0.10, 0.10
d0 = D[0, 1:]
I, J = np.triu_indices(n - 1, k=1)
dij = D[1:, 1:]
scale = np.mean(d0)
s = (d0[I] + d0[J] - lam * dij[I, J] + mu * np.abs(d0[I] - d0[J])) / scale
s_scaled = (d0[I] * 1e-3 + d0[J] * 1e-3 - lam * dij[I, J] * 1e-3
            + mu * np.abs(d0[I] - d0[J]) * 1e-3) / (scale * 1e-3)
rank = lambda v: np.argsort(np.argsort(v))
RESULT = {
    "n": n,
    "pairs": int(len(I)),
    "score_mean": round(float(np.mean(s)), 6),
    "score_std": round(float(np.std(s)), 6),
    "frac_positive": round(float(np.mean(s > 0)), 6),
    "scale_invariance_max_abs_diff": float(np.max(np.abs(s - s_scaled))),
    "rank_corr_scaled": float(np.corrcoef(rank(s), rank(s_scaled))[0, 1]),
    "radius_priority_corr": round(float(np.corrcoef(s, d0[I] + d0[J])[0, 1]), 6),
    "lam_sensitivity_mean_s": {str(l): round(float(np.mean(
        (d0[I] + d0[J] - l * dij[I, J] + mu * np.abs(d0[I] - d0[J])) / scale)), 6)
        for l in (1.0, 1.05, 1.15, 1.3)},
}
print(RESULT)
